{{Quote|I am Master Cassa. Two paths lay before you. Choose carefully, for once you start down one, the other is forever closed.|translated=1|Cassa Hun|<ref name="Advanced Training" />}}
'''Cassa Hun''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] who served the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] with the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. During his [[Time/Legends|time]] on the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]] staging area of [[Carrick Station]] and the Republic [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], Hun [[Jedi instructor|trained]] young [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knights]] to become either [[Jedi Sentinel/Legends|Jedi Sentinels]] or [[Jedi Guardian/Legends|Jedi Guardians]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|You have chosen your path. To discover where it leads, you must follow it.|translated=1|Cassa Hun|<ref name="Advanced Training" />}}
A [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] who served the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] against the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]], Cassa Hun traveled between the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy's]] [[Carrick Station]] and the Republic [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] frequently. On Carrick Station, Hun's friend and fellow Jedi Master, [[Nimi]], often directed newly-arrived [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knights]] to speak with the Twi'lek Jedi about undergoing training to become either a [[Jedi Sentinel/Legends|Jedi Sentinel]] or [[Jedi Guardian/Legends|Jedi Guardian]]. Hun would [[Jedi instructor|teach]] those Knights about the two training paths, and he frequently gave his students an additional [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] if they chose to become a Sentinel, or additional [[Armor/Legends|armor]] if they chose the path of a Guardian. One such student<ref name="Advanced Training" /> in [[3643 BBY]]<ref name="Time">{{TOR_dates|1}}</ref> was the [[Hero of Tython|former apprentice]] of Jedi Master [[Orgus Din]], and the newly-Knighted Jedi spoke with Hun on either Coruscant or Carrick Station not long after departing the Jedi Order's [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of [[Tython/Legends|Tython]].<ref name="Advanced Training" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|May the Force guide your steps.|translated=1|Cassa Hun|<ref name="Advanced Training" />}}
A [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Lethan/Legends|Lethan]] Twi'lek, Cassa Hun had pinkish-[[Color/Legends|red]] skin and green [[Eye/Legends|eyes]], and the Jedi wore tan [[Jedi apparel/Legends|robes]] while carrying his single lightsaber. He spoke [[Twi'leki/Legends|Twi'leki]] instead of [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Galactic Basic Standard]], and he put his knowledge of Jedi training and philosophy to use while teaching young Knights of the Order.<ref name="Advanced Training" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|But first, you must learn to focus your ability. You must choose which path you will walk.|Master Nimi instructs players to seek out Cassa Hun|<ref name="Advanced Training" />}}
Cassa Hun first appeared in the [[BioWare]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' as the Advanced Class Trainer for the Jedi Knight. He appears on both Carrick Station and the planet Coruscant, though as the player receives the mission "Advanced Training" on the [[Space station/Legends|space station]], this article assumes Hun met with the player on Carrick Station. Upon speaking with Hun, the player decides to pursue either the Guardian or Sentinel advanced class and then receives the chosen class's additional gear,<ref name="Advanced Training" /> and both of Hun's locations are marked in the ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Explorer's Guide]]'' that was released alongside the game in [[2011]].<ref name="Explore">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Explorer's Guide]]''</ref> Hun and the rest of the Advanced Class Trainers were removed in Game Update 5.0 on [[November 29]], [[2016]], when advanced classes were made available on character creation rather than level 10.<ref name="5.0">{{TORweb|url=patchnotes/11292016/game-update-5.0-knights-eternal-throne-early-access|text=Game Update 5.0: Knights of the Eternal Throne Early Access Patch Notes}}</ref>
